population.imf_omission_policy: Chabrier on each namelist read; explicit invalid identifiers are rejected
population.miller_scalo_variant: continuous three-power-law dN/dm approximation: slopes -1.4,-2.5,-3.3; breaks 1,10 Msun; endpoint slopes continued over configured support, including 0.08--0.1 and 100--120 Msun
population.chabrier_variant: existing individual-star form: mc=0.079 Msun, sigma_log10=0.69, dN/dm high-mass slope -2.3 with a continuous join at 1 Msun
population.imf_normalization: integral(m*phi(m) dm) over the configured support equals one unit of initial SSP mass

source_basis.fail_closed_rule: all other recognized bases are rejected until a basis-specific integration path is implemented

channel_partition.rule: A progenitor may occupy overlapping raw mass ranges only when channel ownership is disjoint in evolutionary phase; no ejecta packet may be represented by two channels.

2.name: AGB
must_exclude: wind packets already assigned to channel 1

3.name: SNII
3.ownership: source-node-resolved core-collapse terminal outcome and remnant/fallback; failed/direct-collapse nodes carry explicit zero terminal ejecta
must_exclude: pre-SN wind packets already assigned to channel 1

4.name: SNIa
4.ownership: binary event convolution, not ordinary IMF mass integration

5.name: PISN
5.ownership: complete-disruption event only; no terminal remnant owner

cumulative_contract.returned_mass_definition: actual material returned to gas, cumulative per initial star before the production runtime's single IMF convolution
cumulative_contract.ejecta_definition: non-negative actual mass in the eleven tracked elements; sum(tracked_ejecta)<=returned_mass
cumulative_contract.untracked_ejecta_definition: returned_mass-sum(tracked_ejecta); non-negative omitted-element mass deposited only into the generic metal scalar
cumulative_contract.net_yield_definition: diagnostic newly produced/consumed material; never a gas-mass source
cumulative_contract.energy_definition: cumulative physical erg per initial star before the production runtime's single IMF convolution
cumulative_contract.momentum_definition: cumulative net directed momentum vector in physical g cm/s per initial star before the production runtime's single IMF convolution, expressed in the stellar comoving frame
cumulative_contract.isotropic_source_momentum_rule: An unresolved isotropic wind or explosion has zero net source-frame vector momentum; do not encode scalar radial momentum along an arbitrary Cartesian direction.
cumulative_contract.advective_momentum_rule: The runtime adds returned_mass times the source particle velocity separately, preserving the bulk momentum carried by returned material.
cumulative_contract.radial_momentum_rule: Outward shell momentum is a non-negative scalar subgrid/deposition budget, not one of the three canonical source-frame vector components.
cumulative_contract.release_history: must be cumulative or deterministically converted from a declared rate table exactly once

grid_contract.out_of_domain_policy: fail_closed; no endpoint clamp or extrapolation

chemistry_scope.untracked_mass_handling: Preserve omitted-element mass as returned_mass-sum(tracked); add it to generic metallicity but never fabricate an individual-element assignment.
chemistry_scope.publication_rule: Do not describe the 11-field model as complete nucleosynthesis; quantify omitted-species effects before element-abundance claims.
